shared_elements: quadruped with head and legs shown from the side
band of repeated geometric units (rectangles/discs) as a register divider
vertically stacked registers of motifs on a tall slab/pillar face
carving confined to a flat panel with plain ground
justification: Both depict flat, schematic low-relief animals in strict profile stacked in vertical succession on a tall slab, separated or headed by a band of repeated rectangular/disc-like units, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme. However, A's content is legible and varied (row of crouching creatures over a net/zigzag band, a large feline-like quadruped, a long-necked bird, arm-like elements) while B shows only a narrow marginal strip of comparable figures with the bulk of the surface undecorated, so no individual motif can be matched one-to-one.
